inputs.text:
Production game UI artwork for one coherent 2D military comic game. Hand inked clean outlines, restrained angular cel shading, matte midnight navy and desaturated blue grey painted steel, fine warm grey edge wear, tiny muted turquoise indicator lights. Flat front view, orthographic, crisp shapes, understated professional game art, no photorealism, no 3D render, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Quiet readable surfaces, no busy patterns, no neon glow.
One square blank game interface panel filling the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge. A narrow illustrated steel frame confined to outermost 6 percent, small squared reinforced corners, sparse tiny bolts in corners only. Center 88 percent is completely empty uniform very dark navy painted metal. Straight rectangular edges touch all four canvas boundaries, no surrounding background, no inset floating object, no compartments. IMPORTANT: The exterior edge and ALL four canvas corners must be dark navy blue, NOT WHITE. No bright white outline. Frame is muted dark blue grey steel with low contrast edge highlights. No pale silver rim.
